d:
Jalen Johnson (16 points, 12 rebounds, 11 assists) recorded a triple-double to propel the Hawks to a 117-112 victory tonight in Oklahoma City. Shai Gilgeous-Alexander finished with a team-high 34 points along with 5 rebounds and 3 assists in the losing effort. The Hawks improve their record to 9-6 with the win, while the Thunder fall to 9-6 for the season.
